'''FC Septemvri''' ({{langx|bg|ФК Септември}}) is a Bulgarian [[football club]] based in [[Simitli]], which currently plays in the [[Third Amateur Football League (Bulgaria)|Third League]], the third tier of the [[Bulgarian football league system]].{{citation needed|date=April 2025}}"}}
